steps.title: Prepare qRT-PCR reaction
steps.instruction: Assemble each reaction using the SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One‑Step qRT‑PCR Kit (Life Technologies, Catalog #11732088) following the kit’s recommended reagent volumes and concentrations.

steps.title: Program thermocycler
steps.instruction: Set the instrument to run the following program: reverse transcription at 50 °C for 5 min, initial denaturation at 95 °C for 2 min, then 40 cycles of 95 °C for 3 sec followed by 60 °C for 30 sec with fluorescence acquisition during the 60 °C step.

substeps.instruction: Amplification: 40 cycles of 95 °C 3 sec, 60 °C 30 sec with fluorescence acquisition

steps.title: Interpret amplification results
steps.instruction: A positive result must display a sigmoidal amplification curve, fluorescence intensity above that of the positive control, and a threshold (C_T) value occurring before cycle 40; samples with C_T ≥ 40 are considered negative, and no‑template controls must show no amplification curve.
